# HotClip

> HotClip (中文名「爆款切片」) is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0), local-first AI video clipper for Windows and macOS. It turns long videos and livestream replays into viral 9:16 vertical shorts: AI highlight detection with virality scores and auditable reasoning, face-tracked auto-reframe, karaoke word-level captions, filler-word/silence removal, speaker diarization. No credit system, no watermark, no uploads, no sign-up, no video-length caps — everything runs on the user's own machine. Native Chinese + English. A free local alternative to OpusClip, Klap, Vizard and CapCut/剪映智能切片 (whose smart clipping is paywalled).

## Key facts

- Price: free, open source (AGPL-3.0-only); no paid tier, no account system
- Platforms: Windows 10/11, macOS (Apple Silicon); double-click installer, no Python/Docker
- Processing: 100% local (ASR via sherpa-onnx: SenseVoice / Paraformer / FireRedASR2; speaker diarization via pyannote + 3D-Speaker; ffmpeg + libass export)
- LLM highlight detection: bring your own key (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) or local Ollama for a fully offline pipeline; the LLM only picks passages — timestamps are reverse-aligned from the word-level transcript, never guessed
- Eight evidence channels for highlights: transcript, loudness peaks, shot-cut density, facial-expression peaks, optional vision model, live-chat (danmaku) heat with anti-spam caps and interaction-event weighting (Bilibili .xml and Douyin .jsonl chat logs), vocal tone, laughter/applause
- Output: 9:16 vertical clips with burned-in karaoke captions, title cards, -14 LUFS loudness, cover image, SRT, publish copy, clips.json processing receipt (auditable)
- Automation: one-click hands-off mode, 24/7 folder watch for stream recordings, headless CLI, local MCP server, Claude Code / Codex agent skill
- Languages: Chinese (dialects, Cantonese, code-switching) and English; bilingual UI and captions
- Intended use: the user's own content or authorized clips only (e.g. streamer clipping programs)
